Warehouse Keeper Romp:
If you're not careful around Aden Castle, you may easily lose your life. Why, you ask? Cause it's near the border, and the border territories are the most dangerous of them all. Well, do you understand now why it's so important to have a warehouse here? Yeah? You can leave all your valuables in storage here! And robbers won't have any interest in stealing from you. They won't even look your way! Your belongings here will be safe and sound. Make no mistake, our warehouse is the safest place around these parts.
